title: Linux guests: the Lima VM on macOS (setup --lima), shared guest layer with WSL, setup --update and the refresh after self update, side-by-side Ubuntu migration and guest removal

checks.descriptionMarkdown: New group `tests/guest_layer.rs`: the Ubuntu pin and its derived names, each guest operation's command lines for WSL and Lima, unsafe directory refusal, the WSL sequence, the guest-neutral and legacy clones files.

New group `tests/setup_lima.rs`: CLI acceptance and rejections, the host checks and Lima install/upgrade, create/start idempotency with exact arguments, `--check`, the guest steps through `limactl shell`, the clone outside-home refusal, another instance untouched.

New group `tests/setup_lima_sizing.rs`: caps and notes on 8/16/24 GiB and 8/10-core hosts, flag validation, free-space checks, running-VM warning, the customize prompt answered by a scripted prompter.
New group `tests/setup_lima_edit.rs`: flags against an existing VM (running and stopped), the update question, stop/edit/start arguments, shrink refusal, equal flags change nothing.
New group `tests/guest_records.rs`: `guests.json` written, merged and tolerant of missing/unparsable files; doctor text and JSON for running, stopped, retired and missing guests and missing Lima.

New group `tests/setup_update.rs`: `setup.json` recording, `--update` per project root with each root's pins, vanished root, nothing recorded, no `apt-get upgrade` on a native Linux host, CLI conflicts.

New group `tests/guest_refresh.rs`: per-guest question, `--yes`, no terminal, Lima start/stop around the refresh, Linux `rayx`, apt update/upgrade with and without `-y`, inner `setup --update`, a failing guest not stopping the next, `--check` without starting a VM.

New group `tests/self_update_refresh.rs`: refresh offered after an install only when records exist; yes, `--yes`, no, no terminal; exit code propagation; executable captured before the install; `--check`/up to date/failed install never refresh.

New group `tests/guest_migration.rs`: version comparison, dirty-clone listing, declined/unanswerable, newer-than-pin, Lima rename/create/clone/setup sequence with the record after each step and resume, WSL side-by-side install with first-user stop and resume.

New group `tests/guest_remove.rs`: `lima remove` and `wsl remove` command lines and record update, unrecorded names refused, wrong OS, dirty-clone warning, declined, no terminal, `--yes`, current-guest message.
New group `tests/readme_guests.rs`: README sections for every new flag and command, and `--help` output of `setup`, `self update`, `lima remove`, `wsl remove`.
`cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, as CI runs it: the new modules and test groups must be warning-free.

Every group the epic adds plus the existing groups that exercise touched code: `wsl_plan`, `wsl_install`, `wsl_disk` (WSL moved onto the guest layer, clones file), `doctor` (guest section), `self_update` (update flow), `cli_surface` (new flags and commands), `setup_engine` and `setup_update_prompt` (run_plan recording, prompter), `project_pins` (new pin), `setup_macos` (`brew_program` reuse). Not the whole suite: the app pipeline, fmt and release configuration are untouched.
New group `tests/guest_repairs_flow.rs`: flags with a migration, early recording and a failed first run, the refresh after a migration.
New group `tests/guest_repairs_safety.rs`: failed reads versus missing guests, `--check` without prompts or starts, honest record reads, clone de-duplication.

sprints.title: Ubuntu pin, shared guest layer, and the Lima VM flow

tasks.title: Ubuntu pin and the guest layer, with WSL moved onto it
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the Ubuntu pin to `project::pins` (built-in only) and `Pins`, and show it in doctor's pin list. Create `src/setup/guest.rs` (`Guest`, `GuestKind`, the script command, `ensure_linux_binary`, `clone_checkout`/`clone_script`, `run_setup_inside`, `os_version`, `dirty_clones`) by moving the operations out of `src/setup/wsl.rs`; make `setup::wsl` use them with `Ubuntu-<pin>`. Rename the in-guest clones file to `$HOME/.config/rayx/clones` and make `src/wsl.rs` read it plus the legacy `wsl-clones`. Keep `wsl_plan`/`wsl_install`/`wsl_disk` passing (adjust only expectations this task changes on purpose: the clones file name). Write `tests/guest_layer.rs`.

tasks.title: rayx setup --lima: host checks, Lima, VM create/start, guest steps
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: CLI: `--lima`, the `--vm-*` flags (parsed, validated in t03), `--clone` requiring `--wsl` or `--lima` (an `ArgGroup`), conflicts. Create `src/setup/lima.rs`: macOS version, Homebrew, `limactl --version` with install/upgrade under the outdated rule, `limactl list --json` parsing (one object per line), create/start with the exact arguments from LIMA-3 using `VmSettings` defaults (sizing caps and prompts arrive in t03), `RAYX_LIMA_BINARY`, clone source under the home, inner setup through the guest layer, and `--check`. Dispatch from `setup::run`. Write `tests/setup_lima.rs` with `Runner::record()` responders for `sw_vers`, `brew`, `limactl`.

sprints.title: VM sizing and customization, existing-VM changes, guest records and doctor

tasks.title: Host capacity caps, flag validation and the customize prompt
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: `HostCapacity` from `sysctl -n hw.ncpu hw.memsize` and `df -k`, `VmSettings::effective` with caps, notes and validation, the running-VM memory warning, a `Prompter` trait (terminal + scripted) and the `Customize? [y/N]` flow on creation only (terminal, no `--yes`). Wire into `setup::lima` before create. Write `tests/setup_lima_sizing.rs`.

tasks.title: Explicit flags change an existing VM through stop, edit, start
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Read the existing VM's CPUs, memory, disk (`limactl list --json`) and home writability (`<dir>/lima.yaml` mounts); compare with explicit `--vm-*` flags; ask as an update; `limactl stop` (when running), `limactl edit --tty=false rayx <changed flags>`, `limactl start`; refuse a smaller disk. Write `tests/setup_lima_edit.rs`.

tasks.title: guests.json and doctor's guest report
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: `src/setup/records.rs`: config directory rule, `GuestRecord`/`GuestsFile` serde types (version 1), read/merge/atomic write (skipped in dry runs). `setup --wsl` and `--lima` record their guest on success (Ubuntu version read through the guest layer). Doctor: Lima version, recorded guests joined with `limactl list --json` (macOS) or the WSL registry view (Windows), text and `guests` JSON, removal hints. Write `tests/guest_records.rs`.

sprints.title: setup --update for the host and guests, and the refresh after self update

tasks.title: setup.json and rayx setup --update on the host
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Record sets and the project root in `setup.json` from `run_plan` after a successful non-check run. Add `--update` (conflicts per UPD-1) and the host part: per recorded root, `Project::discover`, `environment_for`, plan the recorded sets, `run_plan`; vanished roots dropped and reported; nothing recorded message. Confirm no `apt-get upgrade` reaches a native host. Write `tests/setup_update.rs`.

tasks.title: Refresh of current guests in setup --update
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: For each current guest of this OS in `guests.json`: question (prompter, `--yes`, no terminal), Lima start/stop around it, Ubuntu version check hook (migration lands in t09: here an older guest is reported outdated and skipped), Linux `rayx`, `sudo apt-get update` + `sudo apt-get upgrade [-y]` inside, inner `rayx setup --update [--yes]`; continue after a failing guest; `--check` per UPD-2. Write `tests/guest_refresh.rs`.

tasks.title: rayx self update offers the refresh with the new binary
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: `self update --yes`; capture the executable before `install()`; after a successful install, when records exist, the question / `--yes` / no-terminal message, and the refresh seam that runs `<exe> setup --update [--yes]` through `Runner`, propagating its exit code. Write `tests/self_update_refresh.rs` with the fake backend.

sprints.title: Side-by-side Ubuntu migration and guest removal commands

tasks.title: Side-by-side migration for Lima and WSL
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Replace t07's skip with MIG: dirty-clone listing and the question; Lima stop/rename/record/create-with-old-settings/start/rayx/re-clone/setup-per-clone/record; WSL install of `Ubuntu-<pin>`, first-user stop and resume, rayx, re-clone, setup, retire the old entry; removal command printed; resume from the record. Also reached from `setup --wsl`/`--lima` when the current guest is older than the pin. Write `tests/guest_migration.rs`.

tasks.title: rayx lima remove and rayx wsl remove
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: New `lima` command group with `remove <name> [--yes]`; `remove <name> [--yes]` in `WslCommand`; dispatch in `src/lib.rs`. Resolve in `guests.json`, refuse unrecorded names and the wrong OS, list dirty clones when inspectable, confirm, run `limactl delete --force` / `wsl --unregister`, drop the record entry. Write `tests/guest_remove.rs`.

tasks.title: Real Lima on this Mac: create, customize, edit, update, migrate, remove
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: On this Mac, leaving the owner's `gpux` VM running and untouched: build a Linux aarch64 `rayx` inside a guest or with a cross toolchain for `RAYX_LIMA_BINARY`, run MAN-1 and MAN-2 (the 26.04 pin only in an uncommitted local build), remove both test VMs at the end, and record each step with date and result in `docs/manual-verification.md`. Raw logs go to `artifacts-temp/agentx/rayx-cli-guests/`. Any defect found is a finding repaired in the owning task's code with its test group extended.
